audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed between layers. Content read Akali, Akali, Annie, Annie, Akali, Akali, Akali; full read Annie, Annie, Skill, Skill, Annie, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly, and the shape is sound: Akali's Q out-damages a level 1-2 Annie trade, Annie takes 3-5 once she can hold an armed Pyromania into her combo, and Akali retakes the lane from 6 and first item at 49.45% over 1442 games.
audit.corrected: Full layer flipped row-for-row onto the content/packet chart, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], the content 'early' block and spikes[0] all rest on the claim that Annie's stun is not online early and that she must 'burn mana stacking Pyromania before her stun comes online'. Riot's own passive text says she begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
audit.why: Enemy P text: 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.' Her first offensive spell at level 1 stuns. With Disintegrate on a flat 4s cooldown she also re-arms it fast once she has mana, so the level 3-5 spike is availability, not discovery.
audit.corrected: Those three fields now say she spawns armed and tell the player to bait the first stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield never appeared anywhere on the page. It absorbs the burst window Akali's whole pattern depends on and damages her back for attacking into it.
audit.why: Enemy E text: 'Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells', 10s flat cooldown. missingInteractions flagged shield-absorbs-burst.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now name it with its 10s cooldown and tell the player to force it before flipping in.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers; the page tracked only 'Summon: Tibbers' as a vague threat.
audit.why: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1, Molten Shield 10s, Disintegrate 4s. The 130s ultimate is the real all-in green light and the 10s shield is the reason a burst can whiff even when the stun does not land.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding were templates with the champion name swapped in.
audit.why: Annie is stationary with no dash, blink or escape — Molten Shield's move speed burst is the whole of her mobility. That is the specific reason Akali carries here, and it belongs in the text.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around her immobility and her armed passive.

edits.before: Your early poke and mobility let you punish her before her Pyromania stun is reliably up
edits.after: Your Q wins the level 1 trade, but she spawns with Pyromania armed — bait that stun first

edits.before: You can out-trade Annie in the first two levels since she needs to burn mana stacking Pyromania before her stun comes online, letting you poke freely with Q and punish her positioning while she's still passive-charging.
edits.after: You can out-trade Annie in the first two levels, but not because her stun is missing — she begins the game with Pyromania armed, so her very first spell stuns. Bait it onto the wave, then Q her toes and take the trade with your passive auto.

edits.before: Annie's stun proc timing on Q/Pyromania becomes a real threat once she starts pre-stacking passive, catching your engage attempts off guard.
edits.after: Annie re-arms Pyromania in four spells and Disintegrate is a flat 4s cooldown, so once her mana holds up she can keep a stun loaded almost permanently.

edits.before: Poke safely with Q before she has mana/stacks for a stun combo
edits.after: Force out her armed Pyromania, then poke with Q while she re-stacks

edits.before: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: matchup-defining — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. It governs your forward steps. - W Twilight Shroud spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Pyromania: four spells arms it and she starts the game with it up — while she glows white, every commit is a coin flip. - Molten Shield is 10s and eats the burst window you flip in for, and it damages you back. - Tibbers is 130s at rank 1: that is your window.

edits.before: Track Annie’s Summon: Tibbers: Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Flash-Tibbers off an armed Pyromania is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Molten Shield (10s) also eats the burst you flip in with.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by deleting Annie before Tibbers matters: she is stationary and Molten Shield buys her one shield, not an escape.

edits.before: If Annie gets one kill, respect Summon: Tibbers and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Annie opens the score she can hold an armed Pyromania permanently — stop walking into her 625 Q range, farm at your own Q range, and commit only once Tibbers is spent.
